description: This file is a Makefile fragment for building firmware images in the OpenWrt build system. It includes rules and macros for creating various filesystem images, kernel images, and packaging artifacts, with specific configurations for different device profiles and filesystems.

methods.name: Image/BuildKernel/MkuImage
methods.description: Creates a kernel image using mkimage with specified architecture, OS, compression, address, entry point, and data.

methods.name: Image/BuildKernel/Initramfs
methods.description: Builds an initramfs image by calling the corresponding build function.

methods.name: Image/Gzip
methods.description: Compresses a file with gzip if CONFIG_TARGET_IMAGES_GZIP is enabled.

methods.name: Image/Build/targz
methods.description: Creates a tar.gz archive of the target root filesystem.

methods.name: Image/Build/cpiogz
methods.description: Creates a cpio.gz archive of the target root filesystem.

methods.name: Image/Build/squashfs
methods.description: Builds a squashfs image with specified compression and options.

methods.name: Image/mkfs/jffs2
methods.description: Creates a JFFS2 filesystem image with optional padding and markers.

methods.name: Image/mkfs/ubifs
methods.description: Creates an UBIFS filesystem image with specified options.

methods.name: Image/mkfs/ext4
methods.description: Creates an ext4 filesystem image with specified block size and options.

methods.name: Image/Manifest
methods.description: Generates a manifest of installed packages and optionally a CycloneDX SBOM.

methods.name: Image/pad-to
methods.description: Pads a file to a specified size using dd.

methods.name: Image/pad-root-squashfs
methods.description: Pads a squashfs image to a specified size.

methods.name: Image/BuildDTB/sub
methods.description: Builds a device tree blob from a DTS source file using C preprocessor and dtc.

methods.name: Image/BuildDTB
methods.description: Builds a device tree blob with specified source, target, and flags.

methods.name: Image/BuildDTBO
methods.description: Builds a device tree overlay blob.

methods.name: Image/mkfs/jffs2/nand/template
methods.description: Template for creating NAND JFFS2 filesystem images with specific page size.

methods.name: Image/mkfs/jffs2/template
methods.description: Template for creating JFFS2 filesystem images with specific block size.

methods.name: BuildImage
methods.description: Main macro to build all images and artifacts for a device, including kernel, rootfs, and packaging.

methods.name: Device/InitProfile
methods.description: Initializes device profile variables such as title, vendor, model, and supported devices.

methods.name: Device/Init
methods.description: Initializes device-specific build variables and image configurations.

methods.name: Device/ExportVar
methods.description: Exports a device variable for use in build rules.

methods.name: Device/Export
methods.description: Exports multiple device variables and associates them with a filesystem type.

methods.name: Device/Check
methods.description: Checks device profile and sets kernel image paths and build targets.

methods.name: Device/Build/initramfs
methods.description: Builds an initramfs image for the device.

methods.name: Device/Build/compile
methods.description: Builds a kernel or device-specific binary.

methods.name: Device/Build/dtb
methods.description: Builds device tree blob from DTS source.

methods.name: Device/Build/dtbo
methods.description: Builds device tree overlay blob.

methods.name: Device/Build/kernel
methods.description: Builds the kernel image and device tree blobs.

methods.name: Device/Build/image
methods.description: Builds a device image, including filesystem and kernel.

methods.name: Device/Build/artifact
methods.description: Creates build artifacts such as images and manifests.

methods.name: Device/DumpInfo
methods.description: Outputs device profile information.

methods.name: Device/Dump
methods.description: Outputs detailed device profile information for debugging.

methods.name: Device
methods.description: Main macro to initialize, check, build, and dump device profiles and images.
